texts.game: Your Xbox 360 disc of Beautiful Katamari as an .iso, or the folder it was extracted to (with default.xex and d02.dat-d05.dat).
texts.dlc: The game's downloadable content, as the Xbox 360 packages you have (LIVE or PIRS files), or a folder of them. The game installs them at its first start.
texts.settings: The game writes its settings file, katamari.toml, at its first start.
